item.title: Senators introduce new version of Railway Safety Act
item.description: WASHINGTON — A bipartisan group of U.S. senators led by Maria Cantwell (D-Wash.) and Jon Husted (R-Ohio) introduced a new version of the Railway Safety Act today (Feb. 24). The new legislation includes a mandate for wayside defect detectors, an expanded list of hazardous materials subject to higher safety standards, and a two-person crew requirement. [...]Read More...

item.title: UK government moves to revive freight traffic through Channel Tunnel
item.description: LONDON — Freight service through the Channel Tunnel, which ended in 2024, is set to resume after the British government announced it would take control of the only intermodal facility in the United Kingdom able to handle freight cars with European dimensions. The government announced today (Wednesday, Feb. 25) that national rail infrastructure company Network [...]Read More...

item.title: Northeast rail operations almost completely restored after storm
item.description: NEW YORK — Amtrak and rail transit operations are essentially back to normal today (Wednesday, Feb. 25) after disruptions that began Sunday night because of a blizzard passing through the Northeast. As of 7:15 a.m. CT, the train status feature of Amtrak’s website shows no cancellations or delays for Northeast Corridor trains originating in Boston [...]Read More...

item.title: CSX completes data modernization program
item.description: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. — Technology firm Infosys announced it has completed a data modernization program for CSX, consolidating the railroad’s fragmented data systems into a unified cloud-based platform. item.title: Remembering Chuck Hitchcock
item.description: Chuck Hitchcock, well-known modeler and Model Railroader author, passed away Saturday, Feb. 14, at age 89. item.title: Ice storm plagues rehabilitation efforts on Mississippi short line
item.description: TISHOMINGO, Miss. — An unprecedented January ice storm has complicated the efforts of a start-up short line railroad looking to restore freight service in rural northern Mississippi. item.title: A history of Lionel Trains ownership
item.description: For over 125 years, the name Lionel has been synonymous with toy trains. The storied American manufacturer, founded in New York City, has changed hands more than a few times over the years. item.title: Colebrookdale Railroad profile
item.description: The Colebrookdale Railroad, once a branch line of the Reading Company, winds through deep woods along the Manatawny and Ironstone creeks. The 8.6-mile route, traveled on its 2-hour excursions, features high trestles and deep rock cuts. item.title: East Broad Top Railroad profile
item.description: The East Broad Top Railroad was a coal-hauling narrow-gauge railroad connecting mines and small towns to the nation’s standard gauge rail network via the Pennsylvania Railroad. After ceasing operations in 1956, the yard, buildings, and equipment remained largely unchanged. Revived as a tourist railroad in 1960, excursions operated on a 4-mile section of the railroad [...]Read More...

item.title: MBTA seeks new battery-electric, diesel locomotives for commuter service
item.description: BOSTON — The Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority has issued a Request for Proposals for battery-electric and Tier 4 diesel locomotives as part of its efforts to modernize its equipment fleet and upgrade regional rail service.
